title: Officer Shot in the Head Refuses to Give Up
description:
Special credit to Alpha News which interviewed Arik Matson and has diligently followed his incredible story of resilience. Full video here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R3W4P_PLXFs

GoFundMe for Rosalie Martin Family: https://www.gofundme.com/f/support-the-martin-family-after-tragic-loss 
Donation link listed on Joseph Como’s obituary: https://www.helpnetworkneo.org/donate/

Submit a tip! Tips@Midwest-Safety.com

Please consider JOINING for $1 a month. It *really* helps us do original reporting like this. 

CONTACT US:
Complaints? Video submissions? Sponsorships? Collabs? Business inquires? 
Email our board at mn.safety.alerts@gmail.com. 

BE NICE:
The individuals presented in these videos may be suffering from the effects of alcohol, drug abuse, a mental health disorder or simply having a bad day. The videos should NOT be presumed to be representative of their general behavior. Everyone deserves to be treated with respect. 

RIGHT TO BE FORGOTTEN:
Midwest Safety practices the "Right to be Forgotten." If you were the suspect in a lower-level offense, you may email our board to request removal. 
Email: mn.safety.alerts@gmail.com

Days after the shooting, Rosalie's grandmother Brenda Carey launched a change.org petition, calling for better police training in residential areas. She cited the Washington Post's fatal forced database, noting nearly one in four people killed by police suffered from mental health issues and urge specialized training for handling such individuals, highlighting that it was a stray bullet fired by a police officer that killed Rosalie. Brenda's petition followed two others by Rosalie's mother, Jennifer Martin, who called for free universal mental health care, mandatory bulletproof glass, and staff safety training in all child care institutions. The officer involved shooting case remains ongoing. Though a request was made for the Ohio Bureau of Criminal Investigation, it was assigned to the Ohio State Highway Patrol due to an undisclosed conflict of interest.
